title: AI Safety and Review Dashboard
subtitle: A plain-language view of what the system watched, what it stopped, what proof exists, and whether it is safe to use now.
hero_copy: This page is the first safety and review layer for the repository. It shows what the system is watching, what it stopped, why it stopped it, what proof we have, and whether the AI system can be used safely now. Onyx is the AI system behind it; this dashboard is the review layer that decides whether access is allowed and what evidence is required.
landing_steps: Check who is trying to use it
Record what happened and what was blocked
Decide whether it is safe to use now
repo_description_suggestion: Dashboard-first AI safety and review layer for access decisions, proof quality, launch readiness, and auditable Onyx handoffs.
